description: Show the workspace's billing plan, its credit balance, what one approved brief costs in credits, and the plan limits (domains, questions, AI engines, monthly AI checks). Use it before a tool that spends credits or a plan allowance. A plan of 'free_trial' means the 3-day free trial: trial limits apply, and articles written in it carry a watermark and publish once the plan starts. A plan of 'paused' means the workspace has no active plan: it never started one, its trial or subscription was canceled, its billing is paused, or it took the 14-day money-back guarantee. Nothing is deleted, but checks and writing stay stopped until the workspace has an active plan again. Every plan has a 14-day money-back guarantee from the first payment, once per customer, refunded from the Billing page. pricing_url describes the plans.
name: get_plan_and_credits
title: Get plan and credits
